title: Stan Romanek: contactee and hybrid photograph

tellings.quote: >> Well, he he was he was a contact major contacty. He had all these uh beings. They actually had the photograph of the of the uh of one of the hybrids that his wife took.

plain: A Canadian UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells a podcast host about Stan Romanek, a man living north of Denver, Colorado, in the 2000s, who described himself as being in contact with beings. Cameron says Romanek was a major contactee, someone who reports repeated visits, and that there was a photograph his wife took of one of the hybrids, meaning a being said to be part human and part alien.
